data.spec: User requires room→conflict→follow-up→WhatsApp inside product/progress; no dashboard design. Root owns room_service.py + minimal api.py/legacy.py integration. /api/input adds event_id?,conversation_id?; same routes continue room context, returns existing task shape plus conversation_id/room_workflow. /requests/:id/transcript and speech DeviceEvents route room inputs before procurement. Durable existing tasks+room context/progress, same task/requests.updated and board.say SSE. Read-only private room calendar/contact JSON adapter supports explicit simulated demo, no real booking write. Personal WhatsApp worker chosen for low-cost demo; pairing remains required. Backend queue adapter owns new whatsapp_delivery.py: token-protected POST /api/whatsapp/heartbeat {consumer_id,connected:bool}; POST /api/whatsapp/jobs/claim {consumer_id}-> {jobs:[{execution_id,message_id,phone,body}]} at most1, one-shot persisted claim; POST /api/whatsapp/jobs/:id/receipt {consumer_id,status:'sent'|'delivered'|'read'|'failed'|'uncertain',provider_reference?,detail?}; GET /api/whatsapp/status public no phone/tokens. Auth Authorization Bearer token read locally .data/whatsapp/bridge-token, root0700/file0600, heartbeat freshness15s. Jobs expiry120s, no uncertain replay. Queue callback feeds task+board progress; raw contacts/session never SSE/Git. Worker owns apps/whatsapp/ only, Baileys socket client (no browser/UI automation), pairing QR in ignored .data/whatsapp/pairing.png, no incoming-message ingestion. Runtime only explicit utterance-authorized booking-owner messages; no blanket send permissions.
